hypothesis: put_row decodes a lookahead before held-glyph guards. Return the exact lookahead on row exit so print_utf8 need not decode it again. No validation/width/cache/batching/parser-authority change.
build: Fresh serial builds with build-engine-arm.py; control must byte-match retained i26 control. Sources restored in finally before measurements. Selected terminal untouched.
correctness: Both arms: release terminal tests and 64x200 differential streams. Existing exhaustive UTF8 and guarded-tail tests included. No timing before correctness.

engine.primary: Unicode median paired CPU ratio >=1.02, positive signs and six-workload Holm p<.05; all six median ratios >=.98. Operational screen, not equivalence.
engine.stop: Exactly 12 pairs, no pilots/reruns/rescue variants/pooling. If fails reject. If clears requires fresh separate prospective PTY/Ghostty gates before runtime selection.

mechanism: Separate post-timing test-only counters can count decode calls. Never pool diagnostic/instrumented sessions with timing.
limits: Shared-host engine CPU best-of-five sequential pairs, not terminal throughput, screen latency, Ghostty or championship. Codegen/layout also changes; improvement cannot uniquely be attributed to decode count.
